title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Lemon & Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ohm Brew Double Brew Lemon and Lime captures the ultimate citrus pairing in high definition. The inhale is characterized by the sharp, acidic punch of yellow Lemon, waking up the taste buds instantly. This is seamlessly joined by the slightly sweeter, aromatic zest of green Lime on the exhale, creating a vibrant and refreshing flavour profile that never falls flat. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid is versatile enough for both MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) and RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) vaping. It pairs perfectly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.6ohm, ensuring consistent flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Double Brew by the renowned UK mixologists Ohm Brew is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Double Brew provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
